```python
import pandas as pd
file_path = '/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/7cc4acfa-63fd-4acc-a1a1-e8e529e0a97f.xlsx'
df = pd.read_excel(file_path)
sales_cols = ['Burgers', 'Hot Dogs', 'Salads', 'Fries', 'Ice Cream', 'Soda']
subset = df[df['Location'].isin(['Wharvton','Algrimand'])].copy()
subset['Total Sales'] = subset[sales_cols].sum(axis=1)
print('Per-city totals:\n', subset[['Location','Total Sales']])
print('\nSorted by total (desc):\n', subset[['Location','Total Sales']].sort_values('Total Sales', ascending=False))
```
